status: Local read-only source contract review; no canary preparation or execution performed
scope: Final one-row pending-receival canary preparation. No activation, permissions, migration application, deployment, model call or business mutation.
keyBoundaries: Document preparation is not entirely read-only: private Storage/source attestation and server review persist source/draft/binding/audit metadata, even while Inventory execution remains disabled.
Normal Messaging action approve is the commit action: it obtains durable approval, mints a permit and calls canonical execution. Do not click it during preparation-only work.
The model registry has read_invoice, search_catalog, check_receival_duplicates and prepare_pending_receivals only. The prepare tool returns an artifact and has no approval/execution authority.

No unrestricted SQL or model-selected privileged business gateway exists. Caller JWT owns all canonical business RPCs; privileged capabilities are fixed source metadata, permit mint and metering only.
The existing local approval maps are not authority; durable identity/hash/current authorization permit reconciliation across hosted instances.

hostedGates.owner: Fresh caller.auth.getUser in supabase/functions/tenbot/index.ts, never model/body supplied.
hostedGates.dependentCatalogCapability: manageVendorsCatalog, only when a reviewed line has newMaterial
edgeSettings: TENBOT_RECEIVAL_EMPLOYEE_IDS includes exact current caller UUID
hostedGates.executionSetting: TENBOT_RECEIVAL_EXECUTION_ENABLED=true required only for commit; when false action approve fails before durable approval/Inventory creation.
hostedGates.preparationLimitation: With pilot-enabled OFF, even the hosted receival workspace preparation requests are denied. Any preparation-only activation would be a separate scoped decision; execution may remain OFF.

operations.trustBoundary: Service capability can attest fixed source metadata only; it cannot insert catalog or pending rows. Uploaded content and model output remain untrusted.

operations.quantityChecks: Current catalog/package and invoiceQuantityIssues must agree; unresolved quantity/unit contradiction cannot become approval-ready.

checks: Fresh actor active/non-read-only and role capabilities
Source-bound immutable draft and independent catalog permission if relevant

operations.finalWrapper: 20261030190000: policy lock helper + exact permit consumed in same transaction; delegates private tenbot_execute_invoice_receival_core
operations.core: 20261030120000 implementation, current reviewed-line validation replaced by 20261030140000

Execution trigger retains invoice_receival_sources and clears agent_state

immutablePayload.authorizationVersion: SHA-256 of actor UUID + monotonic actor/capability permission epochs
immutablePayload.hash: Server encode(sha256(convert_to(payload::text,UTF8)),hex) over PostgreSQL JSONB text; compare the returned server hash, not a separately JSON.stringify-ed browser object.
immutablePayload.importantDate: Runtime server review currently passes documentDate:null; orderDate is explicit employee metadata, never inferred from invoice date.
immutablePayload.stockingUnit: quantityBasis.inventoryStockingUnit is required null by the accepted pending-only response contract; do not invent a stocking unit from a package label.

original.expectedAfterCommit: Same immutable original SHA/bytes/MIME; lifecycle_state=retained, retained_draft_id=exact durable ID, retained_at populated, agent_state=NULL. Fresh caller-authorized download still verifies original bytes; no public URL.

binding.expected: All identities/hashes match original/durable approval; binding immutable.

draft.expected: One included line; exact selected catalog/supplier/unit/quantity/source evidence, no newMaterial and no Job; no supersession or revocation.

approval.expected: Exact owner/draft/hash and literal confirmation; one unique draft approval, current actor authorization.

permit.expected: Exact identities/current epochs and a single consumed permit after successful commit.

receipt.expected: Exactly one returned UUID, empty created_catalog_records, matching approval/hash; receipt immutable.

claim.expected: Unique normalized supplier+reference and unique original SHA bind the same execution; exact original cannot create a second invoice batch.

pending.where: id in exact returned createdRecordIds, under the same employee JWT/RLS
pending.expected: One pending row, exact approved quantity/unit/supplier/material/size, quantity_received=0, no Job/temporary label, no received actor/date or receipt item/transaction link; notes identify invoice reference and durable draft.

narrowChecks: No inventory_transactions rows with pending_receival_id in the exact returned IDs
No pending_receival_receipt_batches rows with pending_receival_id in the exact returned IDs
No receipt links/quantity_received on the returned pending row
If comparing on-hand quantity before/after, pin only approved caller-visible material/location stock IDs and quantity/unit; do not hash or capture unrelated live business rows.
stock.warning: Runtime return onHandChanged:false is a declared contract value, not an independently measured stock diff. Shared unrelated activity must not be misattributed to the canary.

idempotency.key: Exact durable draftId/hash/approvalId with owner and current authorization
databaseGuards: invoice_receival_executions draft_id primary key, approval_id unique
invoice_receival_document_claims document_key primary key, attachment_sha256 unique, draft_id unique
Actor/draft/resource locks and single-use same-transaction permit
idempotency.exactRetry: A committed receipt is reconciled under fresh current permission/RLS and returns original createdRecordIds with idempotent:true; no second pending or catalog row. Do not create another invoice/reference to escape uncertainty.
idempotency.afterCancellation: Runtime allows a matching idempotent receipt to report changed current status with a notice; returns original IDs and createdCount=0, not a new write.
recordOnRetry: Same IDs and empty new catalog set
No new stock transactions or receipt batches
Do not discard uncertain inference reservations
idempotency.afterPilotDisabled: The hosted approve route still requires enabled pilot/execution gates and therefore is not an always-available receipt reader. Once write gates are OFF, reconcile non-mutatingly with get_invoice_receival_draft(p_draft_id) using the same actual caller JWT/current readOperationalData+writeBusinessData+adjustInventory, and exact returned pending IDs. Do not re-enable execution merely to inspect a receipt.

cancellation.employeeConfirmation: window.confirm explicitly says cancellation will not affect inventory.
cancellation.authorization: Existing authenticated client and pending_receivals UPDATE RLS; no model SQL, operator service-role update or new cleanup API.
cancellation.safeScope: Only the actual returned canary UUID, freshly verified pending/unreceived with quantity_received=0 and no receipt links. Never locate by an ambiguous material name.
cancellation.postcheck: Exactly that row status cancelled; quantity_received still0; no linked inventory transaction/receipt batch; retain original/durable approval/execution/document claim/audit.
cancellation.importantLimit: Existing Cancel handler has no server-side quantity_received=0 compare-and-set precondition; it is the general cancel-remaining-pending action. A concurrent Receive is outside this canary scope. If any receipt/nonzero quantity appears, stop; no automatic Undo Receive, delete, purge or stock adjustment is authorized.
cancellation.cleanupRetention: Cancel does not revoke or delete the executed invoice/original/audit. Expired abandoned draft cleanup excludes retained/executed originals.

roles.source: src/lib/rbac.ts ROLE_CAPABILITIES + src/lib/auth.tsx accessAllowed/can + accepted build-attempt.json env keys

actualAcceptedBuild.reason: RBAC_MODE is enforced only when NEXT_PUBLIC_RBAC_MODE exactly equals enforced. The accepted fixed build environment omits it.
actualAcceptedBuild.tenDevFrontendEffect: AuthProvider allows active non-Admin profiles in compatibility mode without accessDevelopmentEnvironment. This does not bypass server RPC capabilities, RLS or Inventory auth.can checks.

roles.hardRestrictionVerdict: No hard role-intersection impossibility in the actual accepted build: an active non-read-only Lead can enter compatibility-mode TenDev and has Inventory adjustment/create/cancel capability, subject to actual current DB role bindings. Developer still lacks Inventory adjustment in the declared bundle.
roles.conditionalOnly: If a future build explicitly enables enforced RBAC with TenDev developer artwork, the declared non-Admin bundles do not intersect accessDevelopmentEnvironment and adjustInventory. That is not this accepted build and must not be assumed or changed here.
roles.correction: Earlier statement that non-Admin Inventory+TenDev is impossible was too broad; it omitted the actual compatibility-mode branch. No role/permission change is proposed.
roles.targetAccount: Actual chris_dev UUID/role/current signed capabilities must be established from the separately authorized exact-account lookup and normal sign-in; account name is not authority.

limits: This is exact local source review, not a new database, signed JWT, hosted model or end-to-end write validation.
Current live hosted flags/allowlist/account/material/document/spending and Product approval are separate gates, not inferred from this source review.

Server policy scopes employee/origin/window and each approval scopes an immutable draft; it has no independent global one-document/one-row quota. The reviewed canary payload must contain exactly one line and the single designated account must remain supervised.
